mcqs.question: Which of the following pair of heritage sites has been cited as a successful example of Public–Private Partnership (PPP) in heritage conservation?
options: Elephanta Caves and Dr Bhau Daji Lad Museum, Mumbai
INTACH and the Archaeological Survey of India
Ministry of Culture and the AMASR Act
mcqs.explanation: The Elephanta Caves and Dr Bhau Daji Lad Museum in Mumbai are cited as successful PPP examples in heritage conservation. INTACH and ASI are central to heritage management, while the other options refer to institutional or historical associations rather than PPP success sites.
